record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: Let M be a Riemannian manifold without boundary with a proper free cocompact isometric G-action, and let M[i] be the quotients by a normal chain {G_i}. Is the analytic L2-torsion over N(G) always the limit of the analytic L2-torsions over N(G/G_i), that is, does ρ_an^{(2)}(M; N(G)) = lim_i ρ_an^{(2)}(M[i]; N(G/G_i)) hold?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7.4 (Approximation Conjecture for analytic L2-torsion). A group G satisfies the Approximation Conjecture for analytic L2-torsion if for any normal chain {Gi} and Riemannian manifold M without boundary and with a proper free cocompact isometric G-action ρ(2)an (M; N (G)) = lim i∈I ρ(2)an (M[i]; N (G/Gi)).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a countable discrete group and let $\{G_i\}_{i\in I}$ be a normal chain in $G$, i.e., a descending sequence of normal subgroups of finite index in $G$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I} G_i = \{1\}$. Let $M$ be a Riemannian manifold without boundary equipped with a proper, free, cocompact, isometric $G$-action, and for each $i$ let $M[i] := G_i \backslash M$, which carries a proper, free, cocompact, isometric action of $G/G_i$. Denote by $\rho_{\mathrm{an}}^{(2)}(M;\mathcal{N}(G))$ the analytic $L^2$-torsion of $M$ with respect to the group von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{N}(G)$, and by $\rho_{\mathrm{an}}^{(2)}(M[i];\mathcal{N}(G/G_i))$ the analytic $L^2$-torsion of $M[i]$ with respect to $\mathcal{N}(G/G_i)$. 

Does the equality
$$\rho_{\mathrm{an}}^{(2)}(M;\mathcal{N}(G)) \;=\; \lim_{i\in I} \rho_{\mathrm{an}}^{(2)}(M[i];\mathcal{N}(G/G_i))$$
always hold? Equivalently, does every group $G$ satisfy the Approximation Conjecture for analytic $L^2$-torsion?
artifact.status_search_result: The Approximation Conjecture for analytic L^2-torsion is generally regarded as open. Partial/related results exist: convergence is known in specific cases such as principal congruence subgroups of arithmetic lattices acting on symmetric spaces (e.g. SL(n,R)/SO(n)) with strongly acyclic flat bundles, and the analogous Approximation Conjecture for Fuglede–Kadison determinants is known only for virtually cyclic groups. No general proof for arbitrary residually finite groups or general Riemannian G-manifolds has been established.

status_evidence.title: Approximation of L^2-analytic torsion for arithmetic quotients of SL(n,R)/SO(n)
status_evidence.snippet: Approximation result for L^2-analytic torsion for towers of congruence subgroups; addresses special cases of the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Approximation of analytic L^2-torsion is established only in special arithmetic settings.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on L2-torsion (Lück)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses approximation conjectures for L^2-torsion and Fuglede-Kadison determinants and notes their open status in general.
status_evidence.claim: The Approximation Conjecture for analytic L^2-torsion is open in general.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics of analytic torsion for congruence quotients of SL(n,R)/SO(n)
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic/approximation results for analytic torsion in arithmetic towers.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial approximation results in specific arithmetic cases are known.
